subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the pair of letter-clusters share the same relationship as that shared by the given letter-clusters.

RSPQ ∶ QPSR
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

**The logic followed here is :- First pair of letter-clusters → Reverse of first pair of letter-clusters.**

So,

__
 
• **Option - (1) : CRAX ∶ XARC → It is reverse of first letter of cluster.**
 
• Option - (2) : BEJK ∶ KJBE → It is not a reverse of first letter of cluster.
 
• Option - (3) : MAND ∶ NDAM → It is not a reverse of first letter of cluster.
 
• Option - (4) : TOUR ∶ RUTO → It is not a reverse of first letter of cluster.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option - (1)**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

For, RSPQ ∶ QPSR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c9b9239a2a9f04a92c79e1087d7314a1b75559a55a6a84b6566c8c8f382b27.png] 

Similarly, CRAX ∶ XARC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8464ce07b8b418be08f5ed4596548e0451d93212acc4422f24cbaff984346b57.png] ​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (1)".
